title: Grass: creation budget, distance hysteresis, in-place updates
player_outcome: On medium, high and ultra, walking along the edge of the grass distance no longer causes pops or stutter, and mining or water near grass does not rebuild whole patches.
design: Checked in code: GrassRenderer.Set frees and recreates live grass on every remesh (GrassRenderer.cs:75-83), including liquid- and light-only ones. Update() creates every newly in-range chunk in the same frame and releases exactly at the distance limit (no hysteresis). Shader parameters are set every frame.
Core: GrassScatter also outputs ChunkMeshResult.GrassShapeHash (positions, normals, kinds, flowers) and GrassLightHash.

GrassRenderer.Set: same shape hash on a live chunk → if the light hash differs, rebuild the buffer in place (MultimeshSetBuffer on the existing RID), else do nothing. Different shape → store the clumps and mark NeedsBuild, keeping the old instance visible until rebuilt; count changes reuse the RID via MultimeshAllocateData.

Update(): at most preset.GrassBuildsPerFrame builds per frame, nearest first and within runtime.Budgets.GrassMs. Release only beyond distance + 8 m. Set fade parameters on Graphics.Changed only. Reuse a pooled float[] scratch sized to the largest chunk.
Split GrassRenderer.cs (235 lines) into GrassRenderer.cs and GrassRenderer.Buffers.cs. Add probes grass.live and grass.builds; timer gd.grass.create.
